title: Xanthe and the Orbit
author: J. M. Dunmore
blurb: Yara Dunmore, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
